<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a crafting material that, among other things, can be further refined into [[a carved piece of marble]]. It's also used to craft higher-level stone-work for the [[Graveyard]]. It can either be crafted at either [[stone cutter]] or bought from the vendor [[Cory]].
